```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    "0": {"processing_time": 89, "due_date": 621, "weight": 10},
    "1": {"processing_time": 15, "due_date": 203, "weight": 1},
    "2": {"processing_time": 89, "due_date": 622, "weight": 7},
    "3": {"processing_time": 23, "due_date": 685, "weight": 6},
    "4": {"processing_time": 40, "due_date": 475, "weight": 10},
    "5": {"processing_time": 50, "due_date": 188, "weight": 10},
    "6": {"processing_time": 86, "due_date": 591, "weight": 6},
    "7": {"processing_time": 43, "due_date": 713, "weight": 7},
    "8": {"processing_time": 32, "due_date": 156, "weight": 9},
    "9": {"processing_time": 90, "due_date": 666, "weight": 8},
    "10": {"processing_time": 66, "due_date": 399, "weight": 9},
    "11": {"processing_time": 68, "due_date": 303, "weight": 5},
    "12": {"processing_time": 13, "due_date": 502, "weight": 5},
    "13": {"processing_time": 56, "due_date": 686, "weight": 5},
    "14": {"processing_time": 27, "due_date": 152, "weight": 4},
    "15": {"processing_time": 40, "due_date": 299, "weight": 1},
    "16": {"processing_time": 80, "due_date": 507, "weight": 6},
    "17": {"processing_time": 26, "due_date": 390, "weight": 1},
    "18": {"processing_time": 99, "due_date": 157, "weight": 3},
    "19": {"processing_time": 2, "due_date": 110, "weight": 8}
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Create variables
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Set objective
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[str(j)]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Add constraints
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assigned_once")

model.addConstrs((C[j] >= jobs[str(i)]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(
    jobs[str(k)]["processing_time"] * x[k, j] for k in range(n) if k != i) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j), name="completion_time")

model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[str(j)]["due_date"] for j in range(n)), name="tardiness")

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]

# Extract the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Print the result as JSON
import json
print(json.dumps({"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}))
```
